What each stop can draw, by difficulty

Events a stop of that type can draw from. Every stop also draws from the "Any stop" row. Outlined cells hold fewer than six events. Hover a cell for one-shot and repeatable counts.

How fast each tier wears out, per trail

Share of a tier's events that one careful run draws. Near a quarter, a second run replays much of the first. Hover a bar for pool size and difficulty weights.

Triggered events, by condition

Events that fire only when something happens (a resource runs low, the crop sickens, the journey starts). Most conditions have three to five.

Events by species

Events tied to one species: who you meet, plus that species' hazards, forks and payoffs (Other). Every species has a face for pirates, traders, drifters and station crew.

The other random pools

Strings in each flavor pool. Small pools repeat soonest: names are drawn once per map, epitaphs once per death.

Every event

Search by title, stop, condition or what an event needs. Click a column header to sort. "Needs" names an item that must be aboard, a choice made earlier in the run, or a living crop.
